levelDescriptions.C: 比較選項、協商與複雜情境

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Good morning. Are you looking for the museum?
A.zh: 早安。你在找博物館嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes. I want to visit it today.
A.zh: 是的。我今天想去參觀。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: I can help you find the way.
A.zh: 我可以幫你找路。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Thank you. I am new here.
A.zh: 謝謝你。我剛來這裡。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Do you have a map on your phone?
A.zh: 你手機裡有地圖嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes, but I cannot find the entrance.
A.zh: 有，但我找不到入口。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: The museum has two entrances.
A.zh: 博物館有兩個入口。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Which one is closer to us?
A.zh: 哪個入口離我們比較近？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: The east entrance is closer.
A.zh: 東側入口比較近。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Can we walk there?
A.zh: 我們可以走路過去嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes, but it takes twenty minutes.
A.zh: 可以，但要走二十分鐘。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: That may be a little long.
A.zh: 那可能有點久。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: We can take a bus instead.
A.zh: 我們也可以改搭公車。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: That sounds good. Where is the stop?
A.zh: 聽起來不錯。站牌在哪裡？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: It is across this square.
A.zh: 就在這個廣場的另一側。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Let us go to the stop.
A.zh: 我們走去站牌吧。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: First, walk past the fountain.
A.zh: 先走過噴水池。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I see it near the trees.
A.zh: 我看到它在樹旁邊。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Then turn right at the bookstore.
A.zh: 接著在書店右轉。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Is that the small blue store?
A.zh: 是那家藍色的小店嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. The bus stop is beside it.
A.zh: 對。公車站就在它旁邊。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I can see a sign there.
A.zh: 我看到那邊有站牌。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Let us check the bus number.
A.zh: 我們來確認公車號碼。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: The sign says number twelve.
A.zh: 站牌上寫十二號。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: That is the right bus.
A.zh: 那就是我們要搭的車。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: How often does it come?
A.zh: 它多久來一班？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: It comes every ten minutes.
A.zh: 每十分鐘有一班。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: We have time to buy a ticket.
A.zh: 我們有時間買票。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: There is a ticket machine here.
A.zh: 這裡有一台售票機。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Can I pay with my card?
A.zh: 我可以刷卡嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. Choose one adult ticket.
A.zh: 可以。請選一張成人票。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: The screen asks for a destination.
A.zh: 螢幕要我選目的地。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Choose Museum East.
A.zh: 請選「博物館東側」。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I found it. Is this the right price?
A.zh: 找到了。這個價格對嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes, that is the bus fare.
A.zh: 對，那就是公車票價。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I have my ticket now.
A.zh: 我現在拿到票了。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Here comes the bus.
A.zh: 公車來了。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Does the front sign say Museum East?
A.zh: 車頭是不是寫「博物館東側」？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. Let us get on.
A.zh: 對。我們上車吧。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Do I show my ticket to the driver?
A.zh: 我要把票給司機看嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Just tap it on this reader.
A.zh: 只要在這個感應器上刷一下。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: The light is green. Did it work?
A.zh: 燈亮綠色了。有成功嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. We can sit near the window.
A.zh: 有。我們可以坐窗邊。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: How many stops do we have?
A.zh: 我們要坐幾站？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Usually, we get off after four stops.
A.zh: 通常坐四站後下車。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Please tell me when we are close.
A.zh: 快到時請告訴我。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Of course. I will watch the signs.
A.zh: 當然。我會注意站名。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: The bus is turning left now.
A.zh: 公車現在左轉了。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Is this still the right way?
A.zh: 這樣還是正確的路嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes. There is a small road change today.
A.zh: 對。今天路線有一點調整。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Why did the route change?
A.zh: 為什麼路線改了？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: There is work on the main street.
A.zh: 主要街道正在施工。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Will we be late?
A.zh: 我們會遲到嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: No. The change only adds a few minutes.
A.zh: 不會。只會多花幾分鐘。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: That is good. What stop is next?
A.zh: 那就好。下一站是哪一站？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: The next stop is Central Park.
A.zh: 下一站是中央公園。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Can we see the park from here?
A.zh: 從這裡看得到公園嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes. It is on your left.
A.zh: 看得到。就在你的左邊。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: It looks like a nice place.
A.zh: 看起來是個不錯的地方。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: We can visit after the museum.
A.zh: 參觀完博物館後可以來走走。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: I would like that.
A.zh: 我很想去。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Now we are two stops away.
A.zh: 現在再兩站就到了。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Should I press the stop button?
A.zh: 我要按下車鈴嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Not yet. Press it after the next stop.
A.zh: 還不用。過下一站後再按。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Okay. I will wait.
A.zh: 好，我等一下。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: The next stop has passed.
A.zh: 剛剛那一站過了。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: I will press the button now.
A.zh: 我現在按下車鈴。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Great. Our stop is coming.
A.zh: 很好。我們快到了。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: I can see the museum sign.
A.zh: 我看到博物館的指標了。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Let us get off at this stop.
A.zh: 我們在這站下車。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Which way do we go now?
A.zh: 現在要往哪邊走？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Walk toward the large clock.
A.zh: 往那座大鐘的方向走。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Is the clock beside the garden?
A.zh: 大鐘在花園旁邊嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes. The path starts there.
A.zh: 對。步道從那裡開始。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: I see two paths. Which one is ours?
A.zh: 我看到兩條路。我們要走哪條？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Take the path on the right.
A.zh: 走右邊那條。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: There is a bridge ahead.
A.zh: 前面有一座橋。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Cross it, then follow the green signs.
A.zh: 過橋後沿著綠色指標走。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: The signs point to the east entrance.
A.zh: 指標指向東側入口。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: That is the entrance we need.
A.zh: 那正是我們要去的入口。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Is the ticket desk inside?
A.zh: 售票處在裡面嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes, just behind the doors.
A.zh: 對，就在門後面。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: What time does the museum open?
A.zh: 博物館幾點開門？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: It opens at ten in the morning.
A.zh: 早上十點開門。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: It is almost ten now.
A.zh: 現在快十點了。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: We arrived at a good time.
A.zh: 我們到得正好。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Can I buy a tour ticket here?
A.zh: 我可以在這裡買導覽票嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes. Ask at the desk on the left.
A.zh: 可以。請問左側櫃檯。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: I will ask about the next tour.
A.zh: 我去問下一場導覽。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I can wait near the entrance.
A.zh: 我可以在入口附近等你。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: The next tour starts at eleven.
A.zh: 下一場導覽十一點開始。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: That gives us time to look around.
A.zh: 那我們還有時間四處看看。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: There is a map of the museum here.
A.zh: 這裡有博物館地圖。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Can you show me the meeting point?
A.zh: 可以指給我看集合地點嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: It is in the main hall.
A.zh: 就在大廳。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Thank you. I know the way now.
A.zh: 謝謝你。我現在知道怎麼走了。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: You are welcome. Enjoy the museum!
A.zh: 不客氣。祝你參觀愉快！

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I will. Thanks for your help today.
A.zh: 一定會的。謝謝你今天的幫忙。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Good morning. Are you going to the city museum today?
B.zh: 早安。你今天要去市立博物館嗎？

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Yes. My guided tour starts at one, so I need a reliable route.
B.zh: 對。我的導覽一點開始，所以我需要一條可靠的路線。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The direct train is delayed, but there is another way through Central Station.
B.zh: 直達列車誤點了，不過可以經由中央車站走另一條路。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Could you show me that route and tell me how long it takes?
B.zh: 可以告訴我那條路，還有需要多久嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Take the green line and change to the tram at Central Station.
B.zh: 搭綠線，在中央車站轉電車。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: How much time should I allow for the transfer?
B.zh: 我應該預留多久轉乘？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Allow ten minutes; the signs are clear, but the station is busy.
B.zh: 預留十分鐘；指標很清楚，但車站人很多。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: That should still get me there before my tour.
B.zh: 這樣應該還是能讓我在導覽前抵達。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The machine offers a single ticket and a day pass.
B.zh: 售票機有單程票和一日票。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I only need to visit the museum and come back. Which is cheaper?
B.zh: 我只要去博物館再回來。哪種比較便宜？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Two single tickets cost less unless you plan another ride.
B.zh: 除非你還打算搭車，否則買兩張單程票比較便宜。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Then I will buy one now and another for the return trip.
B.zh: 那我現在先買一張，回程再買一張。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: One ticket covers the train and tram if you stay inside the station.
B.zh: 只要不出站，同一張票就涵蓋火車和電車。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: So I do not need to tap out when I change?
B.zh: 所以我轉乘時不用刷出站嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Correct. Follow the transfer signs instead of the exit signs.
B.zh: 沒錯。跟著轉乘指標走，不要走出口指標。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Thanks. That saves me from buying the wrong ticket.
B.zh: 謝謝。這樣我就不會買錯票了。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The green line leaves from platform three in six minutes.
B.zh: 綠線六分鐘後從三號月台出發。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Does the display show the museum stop or the final destination?
B.zh: 看板顯示博物館站，還是終點站？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: It shows the final destination. Look for Harbor Square.
B.zh: 它顯示的是終點站。請找「港口廣場」。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I see it now. Is there a lift to the platform?
B.zh: 我看到了。有電梯可以到月台嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. It is beside the information desk on your right.
B.zh: 有，在你右手邊的服務台旁。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I have a heavy bag, so the lift would help.
B.zh: 我帶著很重的包，搭電梯會比較方便。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: There may be a short queue, but you have enough time.
B.zh: 可能要稍微排隊，但你還有足夠時間。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Good. I will go there now and watch the display.
B.zh: 好。我現在過去，也會留意看板。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: We are approaching Central Station. Your connection is across the hall.
B.zh: 快到中央車站了。轉乘月台在大廳對面。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Which sign should I follow when I get off?
B.zh: 我下車後該跟著哪個指標走？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Follow the blue signs for the eastbound tram.
B.zh: 跟著往東向電車的藍色指標走。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Should I avoid the signs for the main exit?
B.zh: 我應該避開主要出口的指標嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. The main exit would take you outside too early.
B.zh: 對。從主要出口走會太早出站。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: How many stops are there after I change?
B.zh: 轉車之後還要搭幾站？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Ride three stops and get off at Library Square.
B.zh: 搭三站，在圖書館廣場下車。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I will count the stops and listen to the announcements.
B.zh: 我會數站數，也會聽廣播。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: You will see a brick library on the left after you get off.
B.zh: 下車後，你會看到左邊有一座磚造圖書館。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Is the museum on the same side of the street?
B.zh: 博物館在同一側嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: No. Cross at the traffic lights and walk toward the gardens.
B.zh: 不是。在紅綠燈處過馬路，再朝花園走。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: There are two crossings. Which one should I use?
B.zh: 這裡有兩處行人穿越道。我該走哪一處？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Use the crossing nearest the bus stop, then turn left.
B.zh: 走公車站旁的行人穿越道，之後左轉。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Will I be able to see the clock tower from there?
B.zh: 從那裡看得到鐘樓嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. The tower is your next landmark.
B.zh: 看得到。鐘樓就是下一個地標。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: That makes the route much easier to remember.
B.zh: 這樣路線就容易記多了。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The shortest path has stairs, but there is a step-free path nearby.
B.zh: 最短的路有樓梯，但附近有一條不用爬樓梯的路。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I would prefer the step-free path with my bag.
B.zh: 我帶著包，比較想走不用爬樓梯的路。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Stay on the wide sidewalk until you reach the clock tower.
B.zh: 沿著寬敞的人行道走到鐘樓。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Is that path clearly marked all the way?
B.zh: 那條路全程都有清楚的指標嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: There are signs at every corner, except the last turn.
B.zh: 除了最後一個轉角，每個轉角都有指標。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Could you describe that last turn for me?
B.zh: 可以幫我說明最後那個轉彎嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Turn right just after the tower and follow the garden wall.
B.zh: 走過鐘樓後右轉，再沿著花園圍牆走。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Past the tower, right turn, then follow the wall. Got it.
B.zh: 走過鐘樓、右轉、沿著圍牆走。我記住了。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Construction has closed the museum's main entrance today.
B.zh: 施工讓博物館正門今天關閉了。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Does the garden path still lead to an open entrance?
B.zh: 花園小徑還通往開放的入口嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes, but visitors must enter from the east side beside the café.
B.zh: 有，但參觀者必須從咖啡店旁的東側進入。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Will there be a temporary sign near the café?
B.zh: 咖啡店附近會有臨時指標嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The first sign is beside the tower; the second is near a red awning.
B.zh: 第一個指標在鐘樓旁；第二個在紅色遮陽棚附近。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Is the entrance before or after the red awning?
B.zh: 入口是在紅色遮陽棚前面，還是後面？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: It is just after the café, behind a small row of trees.
B.zh: 就在咖啡店後面，藏在一小排樹後方。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I will look for the awning first and then the trees.
B.zh: 我會先找遮陽棚，再找那排樹。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Your phone map may still point to the closed main gate.
B.zh: 你的手機地圖可能還會指向關閉的正門。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: It does. Can I save the east entrance separately?
B.zh: 沒錯。我可以另外儲存東側入口嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Search for the museum café and save the pin beside it.
B.zh: 搜尋博物館咖啡店，儲存它旁邊的定位點。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Will that pin also help me find my way back later?
B.zh: 那個定位點也能幫我之後找回程路線嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. You can start your return route from the same pin.
B.zh: 可以。你可以從同一個定位點開始規劃回程。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: What if my phone battery runs low before I arrive?
B.zh: 如果抵達前手機快沒電，該怎麼辦？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Write down the café name and use the clock tower as a landmark.
B.zh: 記下咖啡店名稱，並把鐘樓當作地標。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I will note both now instead of relying only on my phone.
B.zh: 我現在就記下兩個資訊，不只依賴手機。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: It has started to rain, and the garden path may be slippery.
B.zh: 開始下雨了，花園小徑可能會滑。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Is the sidewalk sheltered for any part of the walk?
B.zh: 人行道有哪一段能遮雨嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The first block has an arcade; after that, you may need an umbrella.
B.zh: 第一個街區有騎樓；之後可能需要撐傘。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I have a small umbrella. I can stay on the wider sidewalk.
B.zh: 我有小傘，可以繼續走較寬的人行道。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: If the rain gets heavier, bus twelve stops near the east entrance.
B.zh: 如果雨變大，十二號公車會停在東側入口附近。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Would I need a separate ticket for that bus?
B.zh: 搭那班公車需要另外買票嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes, so check the fare before you decide to change plans.
B.zh: 需要，所以改變計畫前先確認票價。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I will keep the bus as a backup, not switch immediately.
B.zh: 我會把公車當備案，不會馬上改搭。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The tour begins at one, and check-in usually takes a few minutes.
B.zh: 導覽一點開始，報到通常需要幾分鐘。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: What arrival time would give me enough time to check in?
B.zh: 幾點到才能讓我有足夠時間報到？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Try to reach the east entrance by twelve forty-five.
B.zh: 盡量在十二點四十五分前到東側入口。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: The tram display now says I will arrive at twelve thirty.
B.zh: 電車看板現在顯示我十二點半會到。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: That gives you fifteen minutes to walk and check in.
B.zh: 這樣你有十五分鐘可以步行和報到。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: If I miss this tram, would the next one still be safe?
B.zh: 如果錯過這班電車，搭下一班還來得及嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: It would be close. Stay near the door so you can get off promptly.
B.zh: 會有點趕。待在車門附近，方便一下車就出發。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Understood. I will take this tram and keep moving.
B.zh: 了解。我會搭這班電車，接著直接前往。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: You have reached the red awning. The entrance is just beyond it.
B.zh: 你已經走到紅色遮陽棚了。入口就在前面。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: There are two doors. Is the one on the right for museum visitors?
B.zh: 這裡有兩扇門。右邊是給博物館參觀者的嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. The left door leads only to the café.
B.zh: 對。左邊只通往咖啡店。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Where do I show the ticket on my phone?
B.zh: 我該在哪裡出示手機票券？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Show it at the tour desk just inside the entrance.
B.zh: 在入口裡面的導覽服務台出示。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: And where does the tour group meet?
B.zh: 那導覽團在哪裡集合？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Wait beside the large map in the lobby.
B.zh: 請在大廳的大地圖旁等候。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Thank you. I made it with time to spare.
B.zh: 謝謝。我順利到了，時間還很充裕。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The tour will end near the gift shop at about two thirty.
B.zh: 導覽大約兩點半在禮品店附近結束。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Is there a simple way back to Central Station afterward?
B.zh: 結束後有簡單的路線回中央車站嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Follow the tram signs to Library Square and ride westbound.
B.zh: 跟著電車指標走到圖書館廣場，再搭西向電車。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Can I use the same kind of ticket for the return journey?
B.zh: 回程也能用同一種類的票嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. Buy another single ticket before boarding.
B.zh: 可以。上車前再買一張單程票。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: What if I leave from the café instead of the gift shop?
B.zh: 如果我從咖啡店離開，不從禮品店出去呢？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Start from the east entrance and follow the same signs in reverse.
B.zh: 從東側入口出發，反方向沿著相同的指標走。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Perfect. I will save the route and enjoy the tour first.
B.zh: 太好了。我會存下路線，先好好參加導覽。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Before we choose a route, what matters most: speed, comfort, or certainty?
C.zh: 選路線前，對你最重要的是速度、舒適，還是確定性？

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Certainty matters most because I have a timed museum reservation.
C.zh: 確定能準時最重要，因為我的博物館預約有指定時段。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The express bus is faster on paper, but traffic near the station is unpredictable.
C.zh: 快速公車表面上較快，但車站附近的交通難以預測。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I would rather arrive a little early than gamble on a shorter journey.
C.zh: 我寧可早一點到，也不想冒險賭較短的車程。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: In that case, the tram is slower but tends to keep its schedule.
C.zh: 這樣的話，電車雖然較慢，但通常較準時。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: How much extra time should I build in for the walk at the end?
C.zh: 最後一段步行，我應該多預留多少時間？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Allow fifteen minutes, or twenty if you want a route without stairs.
C.zh: 預留十五分鐘；若想走沒有樓梯的路線，就預留二十分鐘。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Let us use the step-free route and treat the extra time as a buffer.
C.zh: 我們走不用爬樓梯的路，並把多出的時間當緩衝。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The official transit board and your map app show different arrival times.
C.zh: 官方交通看板和你的地圖 App 顯示不同的抵達時間。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Which source would you trust for a change that happened this morning?
C.zh: 若是今天早上才發生的變動，你會比較相信哪個來源？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The transit board updates directly from the operator, so start there.
C.zh: 交通看板直接從營運單位更新，因此先看它。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I will use the map for directions but verify departures on the board.
C.zh: 我會用地圖找方向，但用看板確認發車時間。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: That separation should keep an outdated map from changing your plan.
C.zh: 這樣分開確認，就不會讓過時地圖影響你的計畫。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: If the board changes again, can we compare the tram with a walking route?
C.zh: 若看板又變動，我們可以比較電車和步行路線嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Of course. We can compare both against your latest acceptable arrival time.
C.zh: 當然。我們可以用你最晚能接受的抵達時間來比較。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: My latest acceptable arrival is twelve forty-five, including check-in.
C.zh: 最晚十二點四十五分要到，還要把報到時間算進去。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: A day pass costs more than two single rides but allows unlimited transfers.
C.zh: 一日票比兩張單程票貴，但可以不限次數轉乘。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Since the route may change, the flexibility could be worth the difference.
C.zh: 既然路線可能變動，多花一點錢換彈性或許值得。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: That depends on whether you expect any other journeys after the museum.
C.zh: 這取決於你參觀後是否還會搭其他車。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I may visit the riverside gallery if the weather improves.
C.zh: 如果天氣轉好，我可能還會去河岸美術館。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Then the day pass gives you a useful backup without another ticket queue.
C.zh: 那一日票讓你有方便的備案，也不用再排隊買票。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Does it cover the tram and the local bus, or only the train?
C.zh: 它涵蓋電車和市區公車，還是只有火車？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: It covers all three within the city zone, but not the airport express.
C.zh: 市區範圍內三種都涵蓋，但不包含機場快線。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I will check the zone boundary before I buy it.
C.zh: 買之前，我會先確認適用區域的邊界。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Your friend has joined you. Does anyone need a route without steps?
C.zh: 你的朋友加入了。有人需要不用走樓梯的路線嗎？

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Yes. One of us needs a lift, and we would like to stay together.
C.zh: 有。我們其中一人需要搭電梯，也希望一起走。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The first transfer has a lift, but the second station is under repair.
C.zh: 第一處轉乘有電梯，但第二個車站正在維修。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Could we leave the tram one stop earlier and avoid that station?
C.zh: 我們能提前一站下電車，避開那個車站嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Yes, although it adds about seven minutes of level walking.
C.zh: 可以，不過要多走大約七分鐘平坦的路。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: That is a reasonable trade-off if the pavement is in good condition.
C.zh: 如果人行道路況良好，這是可以接受的取捨。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: It is paved and wide enough for two people to walk side by side.
C.zh: 它鋪設平整，也夠寬，可以讓兩個人並肩走。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Then we will get off early and keep that route as our shared plan.
C.zh: 那我們提前下車，把那條路當作共同路線。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: A temporary closure has made the signs near the museum misleading.
C.zh: 臨時封路讓博物館附近的指標容易誤導人。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I would rather use clear landmarks than follow signs that may be outdated.
C.zh: 我寧可依靠清楚的地標，也不想跟著可能過時的指標走。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Follow the well-lit boulevard to the clock tower, then cross at the signal.
C.zh: 沿著照明良好的大道走到鐘樓，再從號誌處過馬路。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: After crossing, should the museum gardens be on our left or right?
C.zh: 過馬路後，博物館花園應該在我們左邊還是右邊？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Keep the gardens on your right until you reach the red café awning.
C.zh: 讓花園保持在右手邊，一直走到咖啡店的紅色遮陽棚。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: So the clock tower is our first checkpoint and the awning is the second.
C.zh: 所以鐘樓是第一個確認點，遮陽棚是第二個。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Exactly. Ignore the old main-gate arrow between those two points.
C.zh: 沒錯。那兩個點之間舊的正門箭頭不要跟。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: That gives us a route we can explain to each other if we get separated.
C.zh: 這樣即使走散，我們也能互相說明路線。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The forecast has shifted, and heavy rain may begin before you arrive.
C.zh: 預報有變，可能在你抵達前就下大雨。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Which part of our walking route has shelter without adding too much distance?
C.zh: 步行路線哪一段有遮蔽，又不會繞太遠？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The arcade covers the first block; the library walkway covers the next.
C.zh: 騎樓遮住第一個街區；圖書館走道遮住下一段。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Is there an uncovered section between the library and the east entrance?
C.zh: 圖書館和東側入口之間有沒有露天路段？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Yes, about three minutes. A local bus avoids most of it.
C.zh: 有，大約三分鐘。搭市區公車可以避開大部分。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: We can walk if the rain stays light and switch to the bus if it worsens.
C.zh: 雨小就走路；如果變大再改搭公車。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: That works, provided you check the bus arrival time before leaving shelter.
C.zh: 可以，但離開遮蔽處前要先確認公車到站時間。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Agreed. We will make that decision at the library.
C.zh: 同意。我們到圖書館時再做決定。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Your reservation email says entry closes ten minutes after the booked time.
C.zh: 你的預約信寫著，預約時間過十分鐘後就不能入場。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I want to make sure check-in and security screening are included in our timing.
C.zh: 我想確定行程安排已把報到和安檢時間算進去。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The east entrance normally takes five minutes, but queues vary.
C.zh: 東側入口通常需要五分鐘，但排隊長度會變。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Could we aim to arrive twenty minutes early rather than the minimum ten?
C.zh: 我們能以提早二十分鐘到為目標，而不是只抓最低十分鐘嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Yes. That still leaves time for a brief stop if the tram runs on schedule.
C.zh: 可以。如果電車準時，仍有時間短暫停留。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Let us postpone the café until after the tour so we keep the buffer.
C.zh: 咖啡店延到導覽後再去，這樣能保留緩衝時間。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: That is sensible; the café will still be open when the tour ends.
C.zh: 這樣很合理；導覽結束時咖啡店還會營業。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Please remind me to keep the booking email ready at the entrance.
C.zh: 請提醒我在入口前先把預約信準備好。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Your phone battery is low, and the booking confirmation is stored there.
C.zh: 你的手機快沒電了，預約確認資料又存在手機裡。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I would like a backup that does not depend on the screen staying on.
C.zh: 我想準備一份不依賴手機螢幕的備案。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Write down the booking number and the name used for the reservation.
C.zh: 記下訂位號碼和訂位姓名。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Would staff be able to find the booking with those details alone?
C.zh: 工作人員只靠那些資料就找得到預約嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Usually yes, although a printed copy would make the check quicker.
C.zh: 通常可以，不過印出的副本能讓查核更快。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: There is no printer nearby, so I will save a screenshot and note the number.
C.zh: 附近沒有印表機，我會存截圖並寫下號碼。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: You can also lower the screen brightness and avoid using navigation continuously.
C.zh: 你也可以降低螢幕亮度，避免一直開著導航。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Once we reach the clock tower, the landmarks should be enough.
C.zh: 到了鐘樓後，地標應該就足夠帶路了。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: A staff member says the east entrance has moved to the next courtyard.
C.zh: 工作人員說東側入口改到下一個中庭。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: That differs from the temporary signs. Could we confirm the exact doorway?
C.zh: 這和臨時指標不同。我們能確認確切的門口嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The staff member says to pass the café, cross the small courtyard, and use the glass doors.
C.zh: 工作人員說要走過咖啡店、穿過小中庭，從玻璃門進去。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Are those doors accessible without steps for everyone in our group?
C.zh: 那些門沒有台階嗎？我們同行的人都能通過嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Yes. There is a level approach from the right side of the courtyard.
C.zh: 有。從中庭右側可以走平坦的路過去。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Could you point to that route on the site map before we continue?
C.zh: 在我們繼續走之前，可以在場地地圖上指出那條路嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Certainly. I will mark the café, courtyard, and glass doors in order.
C.zh: 當然。我會依序標出咖啡店、中庭和玻璃門。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Thank you. Now the verbal instructions and map agree.
C.zh: 謝謝。現在口頭指示和地圖一致了。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The entry queue is longer than expected, and your tour starts soon.
C.zh: 入場隊伍比預期長，你的導覽快開始了。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Should we stay in this queue or ask whether reservations use another line?
C.zh: 我們該繼續排，還是問問看預約者有沒有另一條隊伍？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: There is a separate line for timed bookings beside the information desk.
C.zh: 服務台旁有一條指定時段預約者的專用隊伍。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I do not want to cut in front of anyone. Is that line clearly designated?
C.zh: 我不想插隊。那條隊伍有清楚標示嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Yes. Show the booking email to the attendant before joining it.
C.zh: 有。加入隊伍前，先向工作人員出示預約信。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: If we are still late, can the desk confirm whether the tour will hold our place?
C.zh: 如果仍然遲到，服務台能確認導覽是否會保留我們的位置嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: They can contact the guide, though they cannot guarantee entry after the cutoff.
C.zh: 他們可以聯絡導覽員，但無法保證超過截止時間還能入場。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Then we should check in immediately and ask for a clear answer.
C.zh: 那我們應該立刻報到，並取得明確答覆。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The tour ends near the gift shop, and the rain has eased.
C.zh: 導覽在禮品店附近結束，雨也變小了。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: We still have time for the riverside gallery, but I do not want to rush.
C.zh: 我們還有時間去河岸美術館，但我不想趕行程。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The gallery is a twenty-minute walk or a short tram ride away.
C.zh: 美術館步行約二十分鐘，搭電車則很快。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Could we compare closing time and transit frequency before deciding?
C.zh: 決定前，我們能比較閉館時間和電車班次嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: It closes at five, and trams come about every twelve minutes.
C.zh: 它五點關門，電車大約每十二分鐘一班。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Then the tram leaves more time to see the exhibition without hurrying.
C.zh: 那搭電車能讓我們有較多時間從容看展。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Agreed. We can take the tram now and walk back if the weather remains pleasant.
C.zh: 同意。我們現在搭電車過去；天氣若好，回程再走路。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: That balances time, comfort, and flexibility nicely.
C.zh: 這樣能兼顧時間、舒適和彈性。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The westbound stop is across the square, but one platform is temporarily closed.
C.zh: 西向車站在廣場對面，但其中一個月台暫時關閉。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Which platform is operating, and does our day pass still cover the return?
C.zh: 目前哪個月台運作？我們的一日票還能用於回程嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Platform two is open, and the day pass remains valid until midnight.
C.zh: 二號月台開放，一日票到午夜前都有效。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Will the tram take us directly to Central Station or require another transfer?
C.zh: 電車能直達中央車站，還是需要再轉乘？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: It goes directly there, but check that the destination sign says Central Station.
C.zh: 可以直達，但要確認車頭顯示「中央車站」。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: If the sign changes, I will ask the driver before boarding.
C.zh: 若顯示不同，我會在上車前先問司機。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: That is a good final check after all the route changes today.
C.zh: 經過今天這麼多路線變動，最後再確認一次很好。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Thanks. We arrived on time and have a clear plan to get back.
C.zh: 謝謝。我們準時抵達，也清楚知道怎麼回去。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Good morning! Welcome to our café.
A.zh: 早安！歡迎來到我們的咖啡店。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Good morning. Is the café open now?
A.zh: 早安。你們現在營業嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes, we are open until six.
A.zh: 有，我們營業到六點。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Great. I would like a drink.
A.zh: 太好了。我想點一杯飲料。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: You can order at this counter.
A.zh: 你可以在這個櫃檯點餐。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Should I look at the menu first?
A.zh: 我應該先看菜單嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. The menu is above the counter.
A.zh: 好。菜單就在櫃檯上方。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Thank you. I can see it now.
A.zh: 謝謝。我現在看到了。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: What would you like to drink?
A.zh: 你想喝什麼？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I would like a latte, please.
A.zh: 我想要一杯拿鐵，謝謝。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Would you like it hot or iced?
A.zh: 你想喝熱的還是冰的？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Iced, please. It is warm today.
A.zh: 冰的，謝謝。今天很熱。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: We have three sizes.
A.zh: 我們有三種容量。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: What is the smallest size?
A.zh: 最小杯是哪一種？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: The small cup is here.
A.zh: 小杯是這個。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: A small iced latte, please.
A.zh: 一杯小杯冰拿鐵，謝謝。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Would you like regular milk?
A.zh: 你想用一般牛奶嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Do you have oat milk?
A.zh: 你們有燕麥奶嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes, we do. It costs a little more.
A.zh: 有。換燕麥奶要多一點費用。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: How much more is it?
A.zh: 要多多少錢？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: It is fifty cents extra.
A.zh: 要多五角。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: That is fine. Use oat milk, please.
A.zh: 可以。請用燕麥奶。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Okay. Oat milk for your latte.
A.zh: 好。你的拿鐵改用燕麥奶。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Thank you for checking.
A.zh: 謝謝你幫我確認。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Would you like any sugar?
A.zh: 你想加糖嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: No sugar, please.
A.zh: 請不要加糖。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Would you like any syrup?
A.zh: 你想加糖漿嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: No, thank you. I like plain coffee.
A.zh: 不用，謝謝。我喜歡原味咖啡。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: We can add cinnamon on top.
A.zh: 我們可以在上面撒肉桂粉。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: No cinnamon today, please.
A.zh: 今天不要肉桂粉，謝謝。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: No problem. I will keep it simple.
A.zh: 沒問題。我會做成原味。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: That sounds perfect.
A.zh: 聽起來很棒。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Would you like something to eat?
A.zh: 你想吃點東西嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: What pastries do you have?
A.zh: 你們有哪些點心？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: We have muffins and cookies.
A.zh: 我們有瑪芬和餅乾。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Which muffin is fresh today?
A.zh: 今天哪種瑪芬是新鮮出爐的？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: The blueberry muffins are fresh.
A.zh: 藍莓瑪芬是新鮮出爐的。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I will take one, please.
A.zh: 我要一個，謝謝。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Would you like it warmed up?
A.zh: 你想加熱嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes, please. Just a little.
A.zh: 好，請稍微加熱。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Does anyone in your group have a food allergy?
A.zh: 你們同行的人有人對食物過敏嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: My friend cannot eat nuts.
A.zh: 我的朋友不能吃堅果。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Thank you for telling me.
A.zh: 謝謝你告訴我。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Does the muffin have nuts?
A.zh: 瑪芬裡有堅果嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: I will check the ingredients.
A.zh: 我會查一下成分。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Please check before we order it.
A.zh: 請在我們點之前先確認。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: The label says it may contain nuts.
A.zh: 標籤寫著它可能含有堅果。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Then we will not order that muffin.
A.zh: 那我們就不點那個瑪芬了。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: We have a plain cookie instead.
A.zh: 我們也有原味餅乾。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Can you check that one, too?
A.zh: 也可以幫我確認那個嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. I will ask the kitchen.
A.zh: 可以。我會問廚房。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Thank you. We can wait.
A.zh: 謝謝。我們可以等。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: The kitchen cannot promise it is nut-free.
A.zh: 廚房無法保證它完全不含堅果。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I understand. We will have drinks only.
A.zh: 我了解。我們只點飲料。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: That is no problem at all.
A.zh: 完全沒問題。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Thanks for taking it seriously.
A.zh: 謝謝你認真看待這件事。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Will you drink your coffee here?
A.zh: 你會在店裡喝嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes, I would like to sit down.
A.zh: 會，我想坐下來喝。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: There are seats near the window.
A.zh: 窗邊有座位。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Is that table for two free?
A.zh: 那張兩人桌有人坐嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes, you may take it.
A.zh: 沒有人，你們可以坐。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Can I take my bag to the table?
A.zh: 我可以先把包放到桌上嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Of course. I will call your name later.
A.zh: 當然可以。飲料好了我會叫你的名字。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Thank you. We will sit over there.
A.zh: 謝謝。我們會坐那邊。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Your drinks will take about five minutes.
A.zh: 你的飲料大約要五分鐘。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: That is fine. Where do I pick them up?
A.zh: 可以。我要去哪裡取飲料？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Pick them up at the end of the counter.
A.zh: 在櫃檯的另一端領取。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Will you call my name?
A.zh: 你會叫我的名字嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. What name should I use?
A.zh: 會。請問怎麼稱呼你？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Please use Alex.
A.zh: 請叫我 Alex。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Thank you, Alex. Please have a seat.
A.zh: 謝謝你，Alex。請先坐。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Okay. I will listen for my name.
A.zh: 好。我會留意聽你叫我。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Alex, your iced latte is ready!
A.zh: Alex，你的冰拿鐵好了！

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Thank you. Is this the one with oat milk?
A.zh: 謝謝。這杯是燕麥奶的嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. The label says oat milk.
A.zh: 是的。標籤上寫著燕麥奶。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: And this one is my friend's drink?
A.zh: 那這杯是我朋友的嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. That one is a hot black coffee.
A.zh: 對。那杯是熱黑咖啡。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Great. May I have two napkins?
A.zh: 太好了。可以給我兩張餐巾紙嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Of course. Here you are.
A.zh: 當然。請拿。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Thanks. We are all set.
A.zh: 謝謝。我們都拿齊了。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Would you like to pay together?
A.zh: 你們要一起結帳嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes, I will pay for both drinks.
A.zh: 對，兩杯都由我付。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: You can pay by card or cash.
A.zh: 可以刷卡或付現。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I will pay by card.
A.zh: 我用卡片付款。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Please tap your card here.
A.zh: 請在這裡感應你的卡片。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Did the payment go through?
A.zh: 付款成功了嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. Would you like a receipt?
A.zh: 成功了。你要收據嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes, please. Thank you.
A.zh: 要，謝謝。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: How was your coffee?
A.zh: 咖啡喝起來怎麼樣？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: It was good. Thank you.
A.zh: 很好喝。謝謝。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: I am glad you liked it.
A.zh: 很高興你喜歡。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: What time do you open tomorrow?
A.zh: 你們明天幾點開？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: We open at eight tomorrow.
A.zh: 明天八點開門。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I may come back for breakfast.
A.zh: 我可能會回來吃早餐。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: We would be happy to see you again.
A.zh: 很歡迎你再來。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Have a good day. Goodbye!
A.zh: 祝你今天愉快。再見！

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Welcome back. Are you stopping in for a drink or lunch today?
B.zh: 歡迎再來。你今天想喝飲料，還是吃午餐？

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Both, if there is enough time before my meeting.
B.zh: 兩樣都想，只要趕得上我的會議。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Our lunch set includes a sandwich and any regular coffee.
B.zh: 午餐套餐有三明治和任選一杯一般咖啡。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: How long would the set take to prepare?
B.zh: 套餐大約要準備多久？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: About ten minutes for the food and five for the coffee.
B.zh: 餐點約十分鐘，咖啡約五分鐘。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: That should work. My meeting starts in forty minutes.
B.zh: 應該來得及。我的會議四十分鐘後開始。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: We can bring the coffee first while you wait for the sandwich.
B.zh: 等三明治時，我們可以先送咖啡。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Yes, please. That would help me use the time well.
B.zh: 好，謝謝。這樣我能善用時間。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Our house blend is mild, while the single-origin coffee tastes fruitier.
B.zh: 店內配方較溫和，單一產區咖啡的果香較明顯。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I prefer less acidity. Which one would you recommend?
B.zh: 我比較喜歡酸度低一點的。你會推薦哪一種？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The house blend is probably a better fit for you.
B.zh: 店內配方應該比較適合你。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Could you make it as a latte with oat milk?
B.zh: 可以做成燕麥奶拿鐵嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Certainly. Would you like a small or medium cup?
B.zh: 當然。你要小杯還是中杯？

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Medium, please, but not too hot.
B.zh: 中杯，謝謝，但不要太燙。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I can make it warm rather than extra hot.
B.zh: 我可以做成溫熱，不做得特別燙。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: That is exactly what I had in mind.
B.zh: 那正是我想要的。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The sandwich normally comes with cheese and tomato.
B.zh: 三明治通常有起司和番茄。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Could you leave out the cheese and add more tomato?
B.zh: 可以不要起司，多加一些番茄嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: We can remove the cheese, but extra tomato costs a little more.
B.zh: 可以拿掉起司，但多加番茄需要一點費用。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: How much extra would that be?
B.zh: 要多多少錢？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: It adds one dollar to the set price.
B.zh: 套餐價格會多一元。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: That is fine. Please make the change.
B.zh: 可以。請幫我調整。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I will repeat the order before sending it to the kitchen.
B.zh: 送進廚房前，我會再複誦一次訂單。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Good idea. I want to make sure we understood each other.
B.zh: 好主意。我想確定我們彼此理解一致。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Does the sandwich need any other changes?
B.zh: 三明治還需要其他調整嗎？

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Yes. I cannot have sesame. Is it in the bread?
B.zh: 有。我不能吃芝麻。麵包裡有嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I need to check the ingredient list before I answer.
B.zh: 回答前，我需要先查成分表。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Please do. I would rather choose something else if you are unsure.
B.zh: 麻煩你。如果不確定，我寧可選別的。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: This bread contains sesame, but we have a plain bread option.
B.zh: 這種麵包含芝麻，但我們有原味麵包可選。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Can the kitchen prepare it without using sesame ingredients?
B.zh: 廚房能不用芝麻食材來製作嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I will confirm the preparation steps with the kitchen directly.
B.zh: 我會直接向廚房確認製作流程。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Thank you. Please wait for their answer before placing the food order.
B.zh: 謝謝。請先等廚房回答，再送出餐點訂單。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The kitchen cannot guarantee there is no cross-contact.
B.zh: 廚房無法保證完全沒有交叉接觸。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Then I will skip the sandwich rather than take that risk.
B.zh: 那我不點三明治，免得冒這個風險。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Of course. We can order your coffee separately.
B.zh: 當然。咖啡可以單點。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Is the coffee prepared away from sesame products?
B.zh: 咖啡是在遠離芝麻製品的地方準備嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The drink station is separate, but I will confirm the details.
B.zh: 飲料工作區是分開的，但我會再確認細節。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I appreciate that. Please tell me if anything is uncertain.
B.zh: 謝謝你。如果有任何不確定，請告訴我。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I will ask the barista and come back with a clear answer.
B.zh: 我會問咖啡師，再給你明確答覆。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: All right. I can wait a few minutes.
B.zh: 好。我可以等幾分鐘。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The barista confirmed the plain latte can be prepared separately.
B.zh: 咖啡師確認原味拿鐵可以在分開的工作區製作。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Great. Please order the medium warm latte with oat milk.
B.zh: 太好了。請幫我點中杯溫熱燕麥奶拿鐵。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Would you like anything packaged to take with you instead?
B.zh: 還想要什麼方便帶走的包裝食品嗎？

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: No, thank you. I will eat after my meeting.
B.zh: 不用，謝謝。我會在會議後再吃。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I have removed the lunch set and kept only the coffee.
B.zh: 我已取消午餐套餐，只保留咖啡。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Could you check that the price changed, too?
B.zh: 可以確認價格也跟著更改了嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. The screen now shows the price of one latte.
B.zh: 可以。螢幕現在只顯示一杯拿鐵的價格。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Thank you for updating it before I pay.
B.zh: 謝謝你在我付款前先改好。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Would you like a seat near an outlet while you wait?
B.zh: 等候時，你想坐在插座附近嗎？

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: That would help because my laptop battery is low.
B.zh: 那很有幫助，因為我的筆電快沒電了。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The table by the window has an outlet, but it is close to the door.
B.zh: 窗邊那桌有插座，但離門很近。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Is there a quieter table with an outlet farther inside?
B.zh: 裡面有比較安靜、又有插座的桌子嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: There is one at the back, although the signal is weaker there.
B.zh: 後面有一桌，不過那裡的訊號比較弱。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I need a stable connection, so the window table is better.
B.zh: 我需要穩定連線，所以窗邊那桌比較好。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I can bring the coffee to you if you sit there.
B.zh: 你坐在那裡的話，我可以把咖啡送過去。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Thank you. I will keep an eye on the time.
B.zh: 謝謝。我會留意時間。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I am sorry. The drink queue is longer than we expected.
B.zh: 抱歉，飲料排隊的人比預期多。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: How much longer do you think my latte will take?
B.zh: 你覺得我的拿鐵還要多久？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: About eight more minutes. I can check its place in the queue.
B.zh: 大約還要八分鐘。我可以確認它排到哪裡。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I have twenty minutes before I need to leave.
B.zh: 我還有二十分鐘就得離開。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: It should be ready in time, but I can make it to go if you prefer.
B.zh: 應該來得及；如果你願意，我也可以改成外帶。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Please keep it for here for now. I will decide in five minutes.
B.zh: 目前先維持內用。五分鐘後我再決定。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: That works. I will update you if the estimate changes.
B.zh: 可以。如果預估時間有變，我會告訴你。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Thanks. Clear timing helps me plan.
B.zh: 謝謝。知道確切時間有助於我安排。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Your latte is ready. The cup says medium, oat milk, warm.
B.zh: 你的拿鐵好了。杯上標示中杯、燕麥奶、溫熱。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Thank you. Can you confirm it is the plain latte without syrup?
B.zh: 謝謝。可以確認是沒有糖漿的原味拿鐵嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. No syrup was added.
B.zh: 可以。沒有加糖漿。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: The lid looks loose. Could you check it before I carry the cup?
B.zh: 杯蓋看起來有點鬆。可以在我拿走前確認嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Good catch. I will replace the lid and wipe the cup.
B.zh: 你注意到了。我會換個杯蓋，並擦乾杯身。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I appreciate that. I have papers in my bag.
B.zh: 謝謝。我包裡有文件。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: It is secure now. Please let me know if anything else is wrong.
B.zh: 現在蓋緊了。如果還有問題，請告訴我。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: It looks good now. Thank you.
B.zh: 現在看起來沒問題。謝謝。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Would you like to pay by card or mobile payment?
B.zh: 你想刷卡還是用手機支付？

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I will use my card. Could I get an itemized receipt?
B.zh: 我用卡片付款。可以給我明細收據嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Of course. I can print it or email it to you.
B.zh: 當然。可以印出來，也可以寄到你的電子郵件。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: A printed copy is easier for my expense report.
B.zh: 紙本比較方便我報帳。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The receipt now shows one medium latte and the oat milk change.
B.zh: 收據現在列出一杯中杯拿鐵和燕麥奶調整。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: The total matches what you told me earlier.
B.zh: 總金額和你剛才告訴我的一致。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Please tap your card when you are ready.
B.zh: 準備好時請感應卡片。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Done. Did the payment go through?
B.zh: 好了。付款成功了嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes, it went through. Is everything else correct?
B.zh: 成功了。其他內容都正確嗎？

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I just noticed the receipt has the wrong date.
B.zh: 我剛發現收據上的日期不對。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Thank you for pointing that out. I will check the register settings.
B.zh: 謝謝你指出來。我會檢查收銀機設定。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Can you reprint the receipt after it is corrected?
B.zh: 修正後可以重印收據嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. Your payment will not be charged again.
B.zh: 可以。你的付款不會再扣一次。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Good. Please confirm the total stays the same.
B.zh: 好。也請確認總金額維持不變。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I have corrected the date and printed a new copy.
B.zh: 我已修正日期並印出新的一張。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Thank you. This copy has the right details.
B.zh: 謝謝。這張的資料正確了。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I hope the rest of your day goes smoothly.
B.zh: 希望你接下來一切順利。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Thank you. Do you offer online ordering for busy mornings?
B.zh: 謝謝。忙碌的早晨可以線上點餐嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. You can order ahead and choose a pickup time.
B.zh: 可以。你能提前下單並選取餐時間。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Can I still request oat milk and a warm temperature online?
B.zh: 線上也能選燕麥奶和溫熱嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. Both options appear before you confirm the order.
B.zh: 可以。確認訂單前會看到這兩個選項。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: That may save time next week.
B.zh: 那下週可能會幫我省時間。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Please check your order details before you submit it.
B.zh: 送出前請確認訂單細節。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I will. Thanks for your help today.
B.zh: 我會的。謝謝你今天的協助。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Before I recommend anything, what are you hoping to get from this visit?
C.zh: 推薦之前，我想先知道你這次來最重視什麼。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: A quiet place to work, a good coffee, and a predictable departure time.
C.zh: 安靜的工作空間、好喝的咖啡，以及可掌握的離開時間。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: We have seating at the back, though it becomes busy around lunchtime.
C.zh: 後方有座位，不過午餐時間通常會變忙。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I can adapt to some noise, provided the connection remains stable.
C.zh: 只要網路穩定，稍微吵一點我可以接受。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The front tables have stronger Wi-Fi, while the back tables are quieter.
C.zh: 前方座位的 Wi-Fi 較強，後方則比較安靜。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Let us choose a front table away from the door, if one is available.
C.zh: 如果有位置，我們選前方但離門遠一點的桌子。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: There is one near the wall that balances both needs fairly well.
C.zh: 靠牆有一桌，兩項需求都能兼顧得不錯。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: That sounds like the best compromise for today.
C.zh: 那聽起來是今天最好的折衷選擇。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Our seasonal drink is sweet by default, while the house blend is more balanced.
C.zh: 本季飲品預設偏甜，店內配方則比較平衡。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I would like to taste the coffee itself rather than mostly the syrup.
C.zh: 我想喝得出咖啡本身的味道，不想主要只喝到糖漿。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: We can reduce the syrup, although it will change the intended flavor.
C.zh: 我們可以減少糖漿，但風味會和原設計不同。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Could you make it with a quarter of the usual syrup and let the coffee lead?
C.zh: 可以只加平常四分之一的糖漿，讓咖啡味道更明顯嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Yes, but the seasonal spice may stand out more with less sweetness.
C.zh: 可以，但甜度降低後，季節香料味可能會更突出。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: That is fine. I prefer spice to extra sweetness.
C.zh: 沒關係。比起太甜，我更喜歡香料味。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Then the modified seasonal drink should suit you better.
C.zh: 那調整過的本季飲品應該比較適合你。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Please note the exact syrup amount so the order is clear.
C.zh: 請註明糖漿的確切用量，讓訂單清楚。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The pastry looks suitable, but I should verify its ingredients first.
C.zh: 這款點心看起來適合，但我應該先確認成分。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: One person in our group has a serious nut allergy, so certainty matters.
C.zh: 我們同行有人嚴重堅果過敏，所以資訊必須確定。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The printed label lists ingredients, but it does not describe shared equipment.
C.zh: 印好的標籤列出成分，但沒有說明是否共用設備。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Could you ask the kitchen about preparation and possible cross-contact?
C.zh: 可以請廚房確認製作流程及可能的交叉接觸嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Of course. I will not describe it as safe until they confirm the details.
C.zh: 當然。廚房確認前，我不會說它是安全的。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Thank you. If the answer remains uncertain, we will choose something else.
C.zh: 謝謝。如果答案仍不確定，我們會選別的。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: That is sensible. I will return with their answer before taking the food order.
C.zh: 這樣很合理。我會先帶回廚房的答覆，再接餐點訂單。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: We can decide on the drinks while you check.
C.zh: 你查詢時，我們可以先決定飲料。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The kitchen cannot rule out cross-contact for the pastry.
C.zh: 廚房無法排除那款點心交叉接觸的可能。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Then we will skip it. Are there sealed items with complete ingredient labels?
C.zh: 那我們不點它。有沒有成分標示完整的密封包裝食品？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: We have packaged fruit and bottled yogurt, each with its own label.
C.zh: 有包裝水果和瓶裝優格，兩者都有各自的標示。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Please show us the labels before we decide.
C.zh: 決定前，請讓我們看一下標示。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Certainly. I will leave the packages sealed while you read them.
C.zh: 當然。我會保持包裝未開封，讓你們閱讀。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: The fruit looks suitable based on this label. We will take one pack.
C.zh: 根據這個標示，水果看起來合適。我們買一包。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I will add only that item and the two drinks to the order.
C.zh: 我只會把那包水果和兩杯飲料加進訂單。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Please read the full order back before charging us.
C.zh: 扣款前，請把完整訂單複誦一次。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I have one modified seasonal coffee, one plain tea, and one sealed fruit pack.
C.zh: 訂單是一杯調整過的本季咖啡、一杯原味茶和一包密封水果。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: The tea should be unsweetened. Is that included in the note?
C.zh: 茶不要加糖。備註有寫嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Yes. I also noted one-quarter syrup in the coffee.
C.zh: 有。我也註明咖啡的糖漿只加四分之一。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Could you confirm which cup will be marked for the allergy concern?
C.zh: 可以確認哪個杯子會標註過敏注意事項嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The tea cup will carry a clear note, and the fruit stays sealed.
C.zh: 茶杯上會有清楚的註記，水果則保持密封。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: That helps, but please also tell the person preparing the drinks directly.
C.zh: 這有幫助，但也請直接告訴製作飲料的人。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I will speak with the barista before the order goes into the queue.
C.zh: 訂單進入排隊前，我會先和咖啡師說明。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Thank you. Direct communication reduces the chance of a mix-up.
C.zh: 謝謝。直接溝通能降低弄錯的機會。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The kitchen is running behind, but the drink station is still on schedule.
C.zh: 廚房出餐延誤，但飲料工作區仍照原定進度。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Since the fruit is already packaged, could you bring that and the tea first?
C.zh: 水果已經包裝好了，可以先送水果和茶嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Yes. The coffee will take about seven more minutes.
C.zh: 可以。咖啡還要大約七分鐘。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I need to leave in twenty minutes, so that timing should work.
C.zh: 我二十分鐘後得離開，這個時間應該可以。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: If the wait grows longer, I can change the coffee to a takeaway cup.
C.zh: 如果等候時間變長，我可以把咖啡改成外帶杯。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Please tell me as soon as that becomes likely, not at the last minute.
C.zh: 只要看起來可能延誤，就請盡早告訴我，不要到最後一刻。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I will check the queue in five minutes and update you.
C.zh: 我五分鐘後會查看排隊情況，再告訴你。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: That gives me a clear point to decide whether to stay.
C.zh: 這樣我就知道何時要決定是否繼續等。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The table we discussed is free, but the outlet beside it is not working.
C.zh: 剛才談的桌子空出來了，但旁邊的插座不能用。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I need power more than a quiet corner for the next hour.
C.zh: 接下來一小時，比起安靜角落，我更需要電源。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: There is another table near the window with a working outlet.
C.zh: 窗邊還有一桌，插座可以使用。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Is the Wi-Fi equally strong there, or should I use my own connection?
C.zh: 那裡的 Wi-Fi 一樣穩定嗎？還是我該用自己的網路？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: It is usually strong, though the front area gets busy around noon.
C.zh: 通常很穩定，不過中午前方區域會變忙。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I will take that table and use headphones if the noise rises.
C.zh: 我選那桌；如果變吵，我就戴耳機。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I can bring your order there so you need not leave your laptop unattended.
C.zh: 我可以把餐點送到那裡，你就不用把筆電放著離開。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I appreciate that. Please call my name as well so I notice you.
C.zh: 謝謝。也請叫我的名字，讓我注意到你。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I am sorry. This coffee was made with the full amount of syrup.
C.zh: 抱歉。這杯咖啡用了原本的糖漿量。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Thank you for telling me before serving it. Could it be remade?
C.zh: 謝謝你在送來前先告訴我。可以重做嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Yes. We will remake it at no extra charge and put it next in the queue.
C.zh: 可以。我們會免費重做，並排在下一杯。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: How long will that take? I still have a firm departure time.
C.zh: 大概要多久？我離開的時間不能再延後。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: About five minutes. If that is too long, I can offer a refund instead.
C.zh: 約五分鐘。若太久，我也可以退款。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Five minutes is acceptable if the new cup is checked before it reaches me.
C.zh: 五分鐘可以，只要新的一杯送來前先核對。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I will verify the syrup note with the barista personally.
C.zh: 我會親自和咖啡師核對糖漿備註。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Thank you. That is a fair solution.
C.zh: 謝謝。這樣處理很合理。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The revised receipt shows the original drink charge and no remake fee.
C.zh: 更新後的收據顯示原本的飲料費用，沒有重做費。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I appreciate that. Could you confirm the fruit pack was charged only once?
C.zh: 謝謝。可以確認水果只收了一次費用嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Yes. There is one fruit pack, one tea, and one coffee on the receipt.
C.zh: 可以。收據上只有一包水果、一杯茶和一杯咖啡。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: The total now matches the amount shown before the error.
C.zh: 總金額現在和出錯前顯示的一樣。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Would you prefer a printed copy or an email receipt?
C.zh: 你要紙本收據，還是電子郵件收據？

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: A printed copy, please. I do not need to provide an email address today.
C.zh: 紙本就好。今天不需要提供電子郵件地址。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Of course. Here is the itemized copy.
C.zh: 當然。這是明細收據。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Thank you for resolving the mistake without an extra charge.
C.zh: 謝謝你處理錯誤，而且沒有多收費。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Your replacement coffee is ready, and it has the corrected syrup amount.
C.zh: 重做的咖啡好了，糖漿用量也已修正。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Could you confirm the cup label and lid before I take it?
C.zh: 我拿之前，可以確認杯上的標籤和杯蓋嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The label says one-quarter syrup, and the lid is secure.
C.zh: 標籤寫著四分之一糖漿，杯蓋也蓋緊了。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Great. I have enough time to walk to my meeting now.
C.zh: 太好了。我現在還有足夠時間走去開會。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I can put the cup in a carrier if you are carrying your laptop.
C.zh: 如果你還要拿筆電，我可以把杯子放進提袋。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: That would make the walk easier. Thank you.
C.zh: 那樣走路會方便很多。謝謝。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Here you are. I am sorry again for the delay.
C.zh: 請拿。再次為延誤向你道歉。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I appreciate the way you handled it. Have a good day.
C.zh: 謝謝你妥善處理。祝你今天愉快。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: If you visit during lunch again, ordering ahead can shorten the wait.
C.zh: 如果下次午餐時間再來，提前下單可以縮短等候。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Can an online order include detailed changes and allergy notes?
C.zh: 線上訂單能寫清楚調整內容和過敏備註嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: It accepts notes, but please speak to staff about serious allergies as well.
C.zh: 可以寫備註，但嚴重過敏也請直接告知店員。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: That distinction matters. I would not rely on a text field alone.
C.zh: 這點很重要。我不會只依賴文字欄位。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: You can choose a pickup window and confirm the order with us on arrival.
C.zh: 你可以選取餐時段，抵達後再和我們確認訂單。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: That sounds useful, provided the order details remain visible for checking.
C.zh: 只要訂單細節在取餐時仍看得到、方便核對，這樣很有用。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: They do. You can review them before the payment is final.
C.zh: 可以。付款完成前，你可以再次檢查。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I will try that next time and still verify the drink at pickup.
C.zh: 下次我會試試，也會在取餐時再次確認飲料。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Is there anything about today's visit that we should improve?
C.zh: 今天的體驗，有什麼地方是我們應該改進的嗎？

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: The clear updates helped, but the original order note was easy to miss.
C.zh: 清楚告知進度很有幫助，但原本的訂單備註容易被忽略。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: That is fair feedback. We can make the modification more visible to the barista.
C.zh: 這個回饋很合理。我們可以讓調整備註在咖啡師那邊更明顯。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: A read-back at the drink station might prevent the same mistake.
C.zh: 飲料工作區若再複誦一次訂單，也許能避免同樣的錯誤。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I will pass that suggestion to the team without sharing your personal details.
C.zh: 我會把建議轉給團隊，不會透露你的個人資料。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Thank you. I would like the next visit to go smoothly for everyone.
C.zh: 謝謝。我希望下次每個人的體驗都更順利。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: We appreciate the specific suggestion and your patience today.
C.zh: 謝謝你提出具體建議，也謝謝你今天的耐心。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: You are welcome. I will see you another time.
C.zh: 不客氣。下次見。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Welcome to our hotel. Are you checking in?
A.zh: 歡迎來到我們的旅館。你要辦理入住嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes. I have a reservation for tonight.
A.zh: 是的。我有訂今晚的房間。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: May I have your name, please?
A.zh: 請問你的名字是什麼？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: My name is Alex Chen.
A.zh: 我叫 Alex Chen。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Thank you. Let me find your booking.
A.zh: 謝謝。我來找你的訂房資料。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I booked it online yesterday.
A.zh: 我昨天在線上訂的。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: I found your room for two nights.
A.zh: 我找到你訂的兩晚房間了。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Great. Thank you for checking.
A.zh: 太好了。謝謝你幫我查。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: May I see your ID, please?
A.zh: 可以讓我看一下你的證件嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Of course. Here it is.
A.zh: 當然可以。這裡。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Is this phone number still correct?
A.zh: 這個電話號碼還正確嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes, it is my mobile number.
A.zh: 對，那是我的手機號碼。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Would you like a paper receipt?
A.zh: 你要紙本收據嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes, please. I need it for my trip.
A.zh: 要，謝謝。我這趟旅程需要用。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: I will print one after check-in.
A.zh: 辦完入住後，我會印一張給你。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Thank you. I will wait here.
A.zh: 謝謝。我在這裡等。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Your room is ready now.
A.zh: 你的房間已經準備好了。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Wonderful. What floor is it on?
A.zh: 太好了。房間在幾樓？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: It is on the fifth floor.
A.zh: 在五樓。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Where is the elevator?
A.zh: 電梯在哪裡？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: It is around the corner on your left.
A.zh: 轉角左邊就是。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Does this card open the elevator, too?
A.zh: 這張卡也能開電梯嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. Tap it before choosing your floor.
A.zh: 可以。選樓層前先感應一下。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Okay. I understand.
A.zh: 好。我了解了。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Do you need help with your bags?
A.zh: 需要幫忙拿行李嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: No, thank you. I can carry them.
A.zh: 不用，謝謝。我自己拿得動。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: We also have a luggage cart.
A.zh: 我們也有行李推車。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Where can I get one?
A.zh: 我可以去哪裡拿？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: One is beside the front desk.
A.zh: 櫃檯旁就有一台。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: May I use it to go upstairs?
A.zh: 我可以用它把行李推上樓嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. Please return it to the lobby afterward.
A.zh: 可以。用完後請把它送回大廳。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I will. Thank you.
A.zh: 我會的。謝謝。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Breakfast is served downstairs.
A.zh: 早餐在樓下供應。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Is breakfast included in my room?
A.zh: 我的房價有含早餐嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. It is included for one guest.
A.zh: 有，包含一位房客的早餐。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: What time does it start?
A.zh: 早餐幾點開始？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: It starts at seven and ends at ten.
A.zh: 七點開始，十點結束。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Where is the breakfast room?
A.zh: 早餐廳在哪裡？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: It is next to the lobby.
A.zh: 就在大廳旁邊。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I will go there tomorrow morning.
A.zh: 我明天早上會過去。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Would you like the Wi-Fi information?
A.zh: 你需要 Wi-Fi 資訊嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes, please. Is it free?
A.zh: 需要，謝謝。是免費的嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. The network name is on your key card holder.
A.zh: 是的。網路名稱寫在房卡套上。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Do I need a password?
A.zh: 需要密碼嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. It is printed below the network name.
A.zh: 需要。密碼印在網路名稱下面。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Can I use it in my room?
A.zh: 在房間也能用嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. It works throughout the hotel.
A.zh: 可以。整間旅館都能用。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Good. I will connect upstairs.
A.zh: 好。我上樓後就連線。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Your room has a desk and a small fridge.
A.zh: 你的房間有書桌和小冰箱。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Is there drinking water in the room?
A.zh: 房間裡有飲用水嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. There are two bottles on the desk.
A.zh: 有。書桌上有兩瓶。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Can I ask for more later?
A.zh: 之後可以再要嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. Call the front desk.
A.zh: 可以。打電話給櫃檯。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Which number should I dial?
A.zh: 我該撥哪個號碼？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Dial zero from the room phone.
A.zh: 用房間電話撥零就好。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Thank you. That is easy to remember.
A.zh: 謝謝。這很好記。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Our quiet hours begin at ten at night.
A.zh: 我們的安靜時段從晚上十點開始。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: That is good. I want to rest early.
A.zh: 那很好。我想早點休息。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Please call us if the hallway is noisy.
A.zh: 如果走廊太吵，請打給我們。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Will someone be at the desk overnight?
A.zh: 櫃檯整晚都有人嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. The front desk is open all night.
A.zh: 有。櫃檯整晚都有服務。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Can I come downstairs for water late at night?
A.zh: 我半夜可以下樓拿水嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. There is a water station by the elevator.
A.zh: 可以。電梯旁有飲水區。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Great. Thank you for telling me.
A.zh: 太好了。謝謝你告訴我。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Do you need help finding dinner?
A.zh: 需要我幫你找晚餐嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes. Is there a restaurant nearby?
A.zh: 需要。附近有餐廳嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: There are several on the next street.
A.zh: 下一條街有好幾家。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Is there a place with simple food?
A.zh: 有沒有賣簡單餐點的地方？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: A small café is open until nine.
A.zh: 有一家小咖啡店營業到九點。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Can I walk there from the hotel?
A.zh: 從旅館可以走過去嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. It is about five minutes away.
A.zh: 可以。大約走五分鐘。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I will try that tonight.
A.zh: 我今晚去看看。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Check-out is at eleven tomorrow morning.
A.zh: 明天上午十一點退房。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Can I leave my bags here after check-out?
A.zh: 退房後可以把行李寄放在這裡嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. We can hold them until evening.
A.zh: 可以。我們可以保管到傍晚。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Is there a charge for that?
A.zh: 需要收費嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: No. It is free for hotel guests.
A.zh: 不用。房客可以免費寄放。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Do I need a luggage tag?
A.zh: 我需要行李吊牌嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Yes. We will give you one at the desk.
A.zh: 需要。我們會在櫃檯給你。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: I will ask for it tomorrow.
A.zh: 我明天再來拿。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: How is your room so far?
A.zh: 你的房間目前住得如何？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: It is clean, but the lamp does not turn on.
A.zh: 很乾淨，但檯燈打不開。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: I am sorry. May we send someone to check it?
A.zh: 抱歉。我們可以派人去看看嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes. I will be in the room for ten minutes.
A.zh: 可以。我接下來十分鐘會在房間。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Someone can come up now.
A.zh: 現在就可以派人上去。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Thank you. Do I need to stay by the door?
A.zh: 謝謝。我需要待在門邊嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: No. We will knock before entering.
A.zh: 不用。我們進去前會敲門。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Okay. I will listen for the knock.
A.zh: 好。我會留意敲門聲。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Good morning. Are you checking out?
A.zh: 早安。你要退房嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes. Here is my room card.
A.zh: 是的。這是我的房卡。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Did you enjoy your stay?
A.zh: 住得還愉快嗎？

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Yes. Thank you for your help.
A.zh: 很愉快。謝謝你們的協助。

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Here is your receipt and luggage tag.
A.zh: 這是你的收據和行李吊牌。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Can I collect my bags at five?
A.zh: 我五點可以回來拿行李嗎？

A.speaker: COCO
A.text: Of course. We will keep them safely until then.
A.zh: 當然。我們會妥善保管到那時。

A.speaker: YOU
A.text: Thank you. Goodbye!
A.zh: 謝謝。再見！

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Welcome. Are you checking in or leaving your luggage first?
B.zh: 歡迎。你要辦理入住，還是先寄放行李？

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I have a reservation, but my flight arrived earlier than expected.
B.zh: 我有訂房，但班機比預期早到。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Check-in starts at three. I can see whether a room is ready now.
B.zh: 入住時間從三點開始。我可以看看現在有沒有房間。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I would appreciate that, though I understand it may be too early.
B.zh: 那就麻煩你了；我了解現在可能太早。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Your room is not ready yet, but we can hold your bags.
B.zh: 你的房間還沒準備好，但我們可以保管行李。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Could you tell me roughly when it might be available?
B.zh: 可以告訴我大概什麼時候能入住嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Housekeeping expects it around two, but I will confirm before promising.
B.zh: 房務預計兩點左右準備好，但我會確認後再答覆你。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Thank you. I will leave my bags and return later.
B.zh: 謝謝。我先寄放行李，晚點再回來。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: May I confirm the name and dates on your reservation?
B.zh: 可以和你確認訂房姓名與日期嗎？

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: It is under Alex Chen, from today through Thursday.
B.zh: 訂房姓名是 Alex Chen，從今天住到週四。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I found a two-night booking for a standard room.
B.zh: 我找到兩晚的標準房訂房。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Does that booking include breakfast for one person?
B.zh: 那筆訂房有含一位房客的早餐嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes, breakfast is included for one guest each morning.
B.zh: 有，每天早上都含一位房客的早餐。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Great. Could you also confirm the check-out time?
B.zh: 太好了。也可以確認退房時間嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Check-out is at eleven on Thursday morning.
B.zh: 週四上午十一點退房。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: That matches the confirmation email I received.
B.zh: 這和我收到的確認信一致。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: We can tag your bags and keep them behind the front desk.
B.zh: 我們可以替行李貼標籤，保管在櫃檯後方。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Is there a fee, and when can I collect them?
B.zh: 需要費用嗎？我什麼時候能取回？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: There is no fee. You can collect them at any time today.
B.zh: 不用費用。你今天隨時可以來取。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: May I keep my laptop bag with me while you hold the suitcase?
B.zh: 你們保管行李箱時，我可以把筆電包留在身邊嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Of course. We will tag only the suitcase you hand over.
B.zh: 當然。我們只會替你交給我們的行李箱貼標籤。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Could you give me a claim ticket for it?
B.zh: 可以給我一張取件憑證嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. Please keep this ticket until you collect the suitcase.
B.zh: 可以。請保留這張憑證，直到領回行李箱。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I will put it in my wallet. Thank you.
B.zh: 我會放進錢包。謝謝。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: A room is ready now, but it faces the busy street.
B.zh: 現在有一間房準備好了，但它面向熱鬧的街道。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I would prefer a quieter room because I need to work tonight.
B.zh: 我比較想要安靜的房間，因為今晚需要工作。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The courtyard room should be ready around two and costs the same.
B.zh: 中庭房預計兩點左右準備好，價格一樣。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Is the courtyard room smaller than the street-facing room?
B.zh: 中庭房比面街房小嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: It is slightly smaller, but it has a desk and the same bed.
B.zh: 稍微小一點，但有書桌，床也一樣。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: A desk and quiet matter more to me than extra space.
B.zh: 比起多一點空間，我更重視書桌和安靜。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Then I will hold the courtyard room and notify you when it is ready.
B.zh: 那我幫你保留中庭房，準備好時通知你。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Please send the notice by text if possible.
B.zh: 如果可以，請用簡訊通知我。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: While you wait, you may use the lobby seating and Wi-Fi.
B.zh: 等候時，你可以使用大廳座位和 Wi-Fi。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Is there a place where I can take a short work call?
B.zh: 有沒有地方可以讓我簡短講工作電話？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The lounge behind the lobby is usually quieter before noon.
B.zh: 大廳後方的休息區中午前通常比較安靜。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Would I need a key card to enter that area?
B.zh: 進去那裡需要房卡嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: No. It is open to guests who are waiting to check in.
B.zh: 不用。等候入住的房客也能使用。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Is there an outlet near the seats?
B.zh: 座位附近有插座嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes, but please keep your belongings with you.
B.zh: 有，不過請隨身保管你的物品。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Of course. I will work there until you contact me.
B.zh: 當然。我會在那裡工作到你們通知我。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Your courtyard room is ready, and we have kept your suitcase safe.
B.zh: 你的中庭房準備好了，行李箱也已妥善保管。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Thank you. Can I collect the suitcase before going upstairs?
B.zh: 謝謝。上樓前我可以先領行李箱嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. May I have the claim ticket, please?
B.zh: 可以。請給我取件憑證。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Here it is. Could you confirm this is my suitcase?
B.zh: 這裡。可以確認這是我的行李箱嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The tag number matches your ticket, and the name matches the booking.
B.zh: 吊牌號碼和憑證一致，姓名也和訂房資料相符。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Great. Which floor is the room on?
B.zh: 太好了。房間在幾樓？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: It is on the sixth floor, close to the lift.
B.zh: 在六樓，靠近電梯。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: That will make carrying the suitcase easier.
B.zh: 這樣搬行李比較方便。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The Wi-Fi name and password are printed inside your key card holder.
B.zh: Wi-Fi 名稱和密碼印在房卡套內側。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I need a stable connection for a video meeting tonight.
B.zh: 我今晚視訊會議需要穩定連線。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Most rooms have good coverage, but please test it when you arrive.
B.zh: 大多數房間訊號良好，不過進房後請先測試。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: If it is weak, is there another place I could work?
B.zh: 如果訊號不好，還有別的地方可以工作嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The lobby lounge has a stronger signal and stays open all night.
B.zh: 大廳休息區訊號較強，而且整晚開放。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Could you help me check the room connection before the meeting?
B.zh: 可以在會議前協助我確認房間網路嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Call the front desk if the speed is poor, and we will help troubleshoot.
B.zh: 如果速度不佳，請打給櫃檯，我們會幫你排查。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I will test it now and call if I need help.
B.zh: 我現在就測試，需要協助再打電話。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: How is your room? Does everything meet your needs?
B.zh: 房間住起來如何？設備都符合你的需求嗎？

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: The room is quiet, but the desk lamp does not seem to work.
B.zh: 房間很安靜，但書桌檯燈似乎不能用。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I am sorry. We can send someone to check it within fifteen minutes.
B.zh: 抱歉。我們可以在十五分鐘內派人去查看。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Could they come before my meeting begins at seven?
B.zh: 能在我七點開會前來嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. I will mark the request as time-sensitive.
B.zh: 可以。我會註明這件事有時間限制。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: If the lamp cannot be fixed, is a replacement available?
B.zh: 如果修不好，有替換的檯燈嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: We can bring another lamp or offer a different room.
B.zh: 我們可以送另一盞燈，或提供其他房間。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I would prefer a replacement lamp so I do not need to move.
B.zh: 我比較希望換一盞燈，這樣就不用換房。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Breakfast is served from seven to ten in the dining room.
B.zh: 早餐七點到十點在餐廳供應。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I have an early call tomorrow. Could I take breakfast to go?
B.zh: 我明天一早有電話會議。早餐可以外帶嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: We can prepare a simple breakfast box if you request it tonight.
B.zh: 如果今晚提出需求，我們可以準備簡單的早餐盒。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: What would be included in the box?
B.zh: 早餐盒裡會有什麼？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: It usually has fruit, bread, and a drink.
B.zh: 通常有水果、麵包和一杯飲料。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Could you check whether there is a dairy-free option?
B.zh: 可以確認有沒有不含乳製品的選擇嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I will ask the kitchen and call your room with the available options.
B.zh: 我會問廚房，再打電話到你的房間告知可選項目。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Thank you. Please do not place the order until I choose.
B.zh: 謝謝。請等我選好後再送出訂單。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I am calling to ask whether the replacement lamp is working.
B.zh: 我打電話來確認替換的檯燈是否正常。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Yes, it works. Thank you. I can hear noise from the hallway, though.
B.zh: 正常，謝謝。不過走廊有點吵。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I am sorry. Is the noise near your door or farther away?
B.zh: 抱歉。聲音是在門附近，還是比較遠？

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: It seems to come from the lift area near my room.
B.zh: 似乎來自房間附近的電梯區。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I will ask staff to check the area and remind guests of quiet hours.
B.zh: 我會請同仁查看，並提醒房客留意安靜時段。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Could you update me if the noise continues after ten?
B.zh: 如果十點後還持續吵，可以告訴我處理情況嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. Call us again if it does not improve, and we will discuss options.
B.zh: 可以。若沒有改善請再打給我們，我們會討論其他辦法。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I appreciate that. I hope I can stay in this room.
B.zh: 謝謝。我希望能繼續住這間房。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Before check-out, would you like to review the charges on your bill?
B.zh: 退房前，你要先確認帳單上的費用嗎？

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Yes. Please show me the room rate and any extra charges separately.
B.zh: 要。請把房價和額外費用分開列給我看。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: The room rate is unchanged. There is one charge for a late snack.
B.zh: 房價沒有變。另有一筆宵夜費用。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: I did not order a snack. Could you check the room number on that charge?
B.zh: 我沒有點宵夜。可以核對那筆費用的房號嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Certainly. It may have been posted to the wrong room.
B.zh: 當然。它可能被記到錯的房間。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Please correct it before charging my card.
B.zh: 刷我的卡之前，請先修正。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: I have removed the incorrect charge and printed a revised bill.
B.zh: 我已刪除錯誤費用，並印出修正後的帳單。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: This bill matches my stay. Thank you for checking.
B.zh: 這張帳單和我的住宿一致。謝謝你幫忙確認。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Your check-out is complete. Do you need us to hold your bags?
B.zh: 退房辦好了。需要我們寄放行李嗎？

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Yes. My train leaves this evening, so I will return around five.
B.zh: 需要。我的火車傍晚出發，約五點會回來。

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: We can hold the suitcase until then at no charge.
B.zh: 我們可以免費保管行李箱到那時。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Could I have a claim ticket, and where should I collect it?
B.zh: 可以給我取件憑證嗎？到時該去哪裡領？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Here is your ticket. Come back to the front desk with it.
B.zh: 這是你的憑證。回來時帶到櫃檯即可。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Will the desk still be open at five?
B.zh: 五點櫃檯還會有人嗎？

B.speaker: COCO
B.text: Yes. It is staffed all day and night.
B.zh: 會。櫃檯全天候都有人。

B.speaker: YOU
B.text: Perfect. I will return before heading to the station.
B.zh: 太好了。我去車站前會回來領。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Before we complete check-in, may we review the terms of your confirmed booking?
C.zh: 完成入住前，可以先一起核對你已確認的訂房條件嗎？

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Yes. My confirmation includes a quiet room, a desk, and reliable internet.
C.zh: 可以。我的確認資料包含安靜的房間、書桌和穩定網路。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I found those notes, but the assigned room faces the street.
C.zh: 我找到那些備註了，但目前分配的房間面向街道。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Since I have an early work call, the quiet-room request is important.
C.zh: 我明天一早有工作電話，因此安靜房間對我很重要。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I can offer a courtyard room, although it has a smaller window.
C.zh: 我可以提供中庭房，不過窗戶比較小。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: A smaller window is acceptable if the desk and connection are equivalent.
C.zh: 只要書桌和網路條件相當，窗戶小一點可以接受。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I will check those details before changing your assignment.
C.zh: 我會確認那些細節後，再變更你的房間。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Thank you. Please tell me the trade-offs before you finalize it.
C.zh: 謝謝。定案前請先告訴我有哪些取捨。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The courtyard room has a desk, but the bed is slightly smaller.
C.zh: 中庭房有書桌，但床稍微小一點。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I can accept that, provided the price and check-out time stay the same.
C.zh: 只要價格和退房時間不變，我可以接受。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The price is unchanged, and check-out remains at eleven.
C.zh: 價格不變，退房時間仍是十一點。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Is the room available now, or would we need to wait?
C.zh: 房間現在能入住，還是需要等？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: It will be ready in about forty minutes.
C.zh: 大約四十分鐘後會準備好。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Could you hold my luggage and send me a message when it is ready?
C.zh: 可以先幫我寄放行李，房間好了再傳訊息嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Yes. We will tag the luggage and contact you after housekeeping confirms.
C.zh: 可以。我們會替行李貼標籤，房務確認後再聯絡你。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: That works. I will wait in the lobby lounge.
C.zh: 這樣可以。我會在大廳休息區等。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The courtyard room is ready. Would you like to test the Wi-Fi before settling in?
C.zh: 中庭房準備好了。你想先測試 Wi-Fi 再決定嗎？

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Yes. A stable video call is the main reason I chose this room.
C.zh: 想。視訊通話穩定是我選這間房的主要原因。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The standard network works in the room, and a wired option is available.
C.zh: 房間裡可用一般 Wi-Fi，也有有線網路可選。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Could you explain whether the wired connection requires an adapter?
C.zh: 可以說明有線網路是否需要轉接器嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: It uses an Ethernet port; we can lend you an adapter if needed.
C.zh: 它使用網路孔；如果需要，我們可以借你轉接器。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I will test Wi-Fi first and use the adapter only if the call quality drops.
C.zh: 我先測 Wi-Fi；如果通話品質下降，再用轉接器。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Please call the desk if you need help before your meeting begins.
C.zh: 會議開始前若需要協助，請打給櫃檯。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I appreciate having a backup instead of relying on one connection.
C.zh: 我很高興有備案，不必只依賴一種連線。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I should mention that the courtyard sometimes hosts small events in the evening.
C.zh: 我應該先說，中庭晚上有時會舉辦小型活動。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Is one scheduled tonight, and when would it finish?
C.zh: 今晚有安排嗎？如果有，幾點結束？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: There is a reception until eight, but it is not expected to be loud.
C.zh: 有一場招待會到八點，不過預計不會太吵。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: My call starts at eight thirty, so I would like to avoid any overlap.
C.zh: 我的電話會議八點半開始，希望不要受到影響。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I can ask the event team to confirm the end time and report back.
C.zh: 我可以請活動團隊確認結束時間，再回覆你。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Please do. If it runs late, what alternative space could I use?
C.zh: 麻煩你。如果延後，還有哪裡能讓我使用？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: A small meeting room is available to guests when it is not booked.
C.zh: 小型會議室沒被預約時，房客可以使用。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: That would be a useful backup if the courtyard becomes noisy.
C.zh: 如果中庭變吵，那會是有用的備案。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: We can text you the room details, but I want to confirm the phone number first.
C.zh: 我們可以用簡訊傳房間資訊，但我想先確認電話號碼。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Please read only the last few digits rather than the entire number aloud.
C.zh: 請只唸末幾碼，不要把整個號碼唸出來。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: That is sensible. Do the final digits match the number on your booking?
C.zh: 這樣很妥當。末幾碼和你訂房上的號碼一致嗎？

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Yes, they do. Please send the message to that number.
C.zh: 一致。請傳到那個號碼。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I will include the room number and check-in details, but no payment information.
C.zh: 我會附上房號和入住資訊，不包含付款資料。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Good. I would prefer to discuss billing only at the desk.
C.zh: 好。帳單相關的事，我比較想在櫃檯談。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: We can do that. Your contact preference is noted for this stay.
C.zh: 沒問題。我們已記下你這次住宿的聯絡偏好。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Thank you for checking before sending anything.
C.zh: 謝謝你在寄送前先確認。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Your booking includes breakfast, although the dining room opens at seven.
C.zh: 你的訂房含早餐，不過餐廳七點才開。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: My first call starts at seven fifteen, so a sit-down meal is unlikely.
C.zh: 我的第一通電話七點十五分開始，恐怕沒時間坐著吃。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: We can prepare a breakfast box for collection from six forty-five.
C.zh: 我們可以準備早餐盒，六點四十五分起可領取。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: What can be included, and can I choose items tonight?
C.zh: 早餐盒裡能放什麼？今晚可以先選嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: There are fruit, bread, yogurt, and a hot drink, subject to availability.
C.zh: 通常有水果、麵包、優格和熱飲，仍要看供應情況。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I would prefer fruit and bread, with tea instead of coffee.
C.zh: 我比較想要水果和麵包，飲料用茶取代咖啡。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I will confirm the final contents and pickup time in writing.
C.zh: 我會用文字確認最後內容和領取時間。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: That way I can collect it without delaying my call.
C.zh: 這樣我領餐時就不會耽誤電話會議。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: I am sorry. The desk lamp in your room has stopped working.
C.zh: 抱歉，你房間的書桌檯燈故障了。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: I need good lighting for a call in an hour. What can you arrange?
C.zh: 我一小時後通話需要足夠照明。你們能怎麼安排？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: We can replace the lamp now, or move you to another room later.
C.zh: 我們可以現在換燈，或稍後幫你換房。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Replacing the lamp would be less disruptive if it can happen promptly.
C.zh: 如果能儘快處理，換燈比較不會打亂我的安排。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Maintenance can bring a replacement within twenty minutes.
C.zh: 維修人員可以在二十分鐘內送來替換的燈。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Please confirm they will knock and wait for my answer before entering.
C.zh: 請確認他們進房前會敲門，等我回應。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Certainly. I will include that in the work request.
C.zh: 當然。我會在維修單上註明。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Thank you. I will keep the area around the desk clear.
C.zh: 謝謝。我會把書桌周圍清空。

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: The courtyard event has continued longer than expected, and I apologize.
C.zh: 中庭活動比預期更晚結束，真的很抱歉。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: My call is about to begin. Is the meeting room still available?
C.zh: 我的電話會議快開始了。會議室還能用嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: It is available for the next hour, and I can reserve it for you.
C.zh: 接下來一小時可以用，我可以幫你保留。

C.speaker: YOU
C.text: Could I use it without an extra charge, since the noise was unexpected?
C.zh: 噪音是預料外的，我可以不用額外付費使用嗎？

C.speaker: COCO
C.text: Yes. We will waive the fee for tonight.
C.zh: 可以。今晚的費用我們會免除。

C.speaker: YOU
